q: 60 M offshore at night you pick up this light where the chart shows a buoy marked ODAS. What is it?
answer: A data buoy — a special mark; pass clear
why: ODAS buoys gather ocean and weather data; they are yellow special marks, often Fl(5) Y 20s — give them a wide berth.
